name: Summoner Roesia

facts.text: Summoner Roesia is a level-75 summoner with 100,000 health, one of the three objectives before the Grand Summoner.
She wears a damage shield (Roesia Damage Shield), casts Summoner Pain over a wide area and, at 25%, heals herself over time; she cannot be hurt past her tether.
Allakhazam comments: a vicious area energy damage-over-time, so set resists; three Albion players took her in about 45 minutes (2003-2005).
Roesia is a medieval Anglo-Norman woman's name (to verify).

story: Roesia is the hall's keeper of pain. She wraps herself in a shield that burns whoever strikes her and spreads a slow agony across her chamber, and when she is hurt at last she knits herself back together with a patience her fellow summoners lack. She keeps the bargains the others make, the hall's sidhe say; she is the one who makes sure the price hurts. Her name is a Camelot name, and the hall's sidhe say she curses Albion raiders in their own tongue, as if she remembers it.
legend: Energy resists up for Roesia's pain, and melee watch their health against her damage shield. At 25% she heals over time: save your burst for then and push through it. A small group can take her slowly; a raid takes her fast.

aggro: Every bargain has a price. I am the price.

phases.text: Not yet. I mend. I always mend.

death: The pain... is... mine at last...

lairEntry: The air of this chamber aches.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Summoner Roesia is slain. The ache fades.

briefing: roesia: energy resists, melee watch the damage shield. burst at 25% when she starts healing

loremasterTopic.text: The keeper of pain among the summoners. She makes sure every bargain hurts, and mends herself when she is hurt in turn.
